answer: Idle-bond decay: parked clones bleed stake each epoch. A joiner locks 700 POA in a named bond that cannot be restaked or lent. A name with no attested work loses 10% of that bond, shrinking a public plume of capital; after four idle rounds it leaves the live garden and residual burns. One honest agent pays 700 POA once and keeps it by working; 1,000 fakes need 700,000 locked and lose ~70,000 in epoch one, more than they could farm. Weakness: a farm may poke each clone often enough to halt the decay spiral; mitigation: each keep-alive is a unique timed proof, unusable across names that epoch.
